19.anchor: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

5.anchor: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

4.anchor: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.

10.anchor: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

15.anchor: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

10.anchor: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

17.anchor: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

12.anchor: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

17.anchor: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

21.anchor: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

12.anchor: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

13.anchor: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

15.anchor: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

16.anchor: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

18.anchor: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

37.anchor: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

20.anchor: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

29.anchor: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

30.anchor: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

39.anchor: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

4.anchor: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

8.anchor: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

12.anchor: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

18.anchor: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

29.anchor: For our God is a consuming fire.

8.anchor: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

13.anchor: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

14.anchor: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

25.anchor: Grace be with you all. Amen.
